::::: {.joinus-container .about-detail-container}

### Individual Members


:::: {.card .members-category .rounded-3 .shadow-sm .border-top .border-3 .border-start-0 .border-end-0 .border-bottom-0}
::: {.card-body .p-4}

Become a member of the OSC if you want to visibly support the goal of open, responsible, and reproducible research within your disciplines or at LMU Munich more broadly. As a member, you can


* shape our activities (e.g. suggest or lead an event, write research practice guidance, organize a meetup, liaise with stakeholders to inform on the design of incentives and policies)
* network with like-minded researchers across disciplines (from networking lunch to writing meta research proposals together), and 
* vote and/or take part in the [OSC Scientific Board](/people/scientific-board.qmd).


According to its [statute](statutes.qmd), all PhD holders (post docs, lecturers, PDs, and Professors) of LMU Munich as well as researchers from other universities or non-university research institutes contributing to foster the goals of the OSC can become members - free of any charge, of course.

<a href="mailto:malika.ihle@lmu.de?subject=OSC%20Membership" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
  Become an OSC Member <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i>
</a>

:::
::::

### OSC Fellows


:::: {.card .members-category .rounded-3 .shadow-sm .border-top .border-3 .border-start-0 .border-end-0 .border-bottom-0}
::: {.card-body .p-4}

Become an OSC Fellow if you are a PhD candidate or a student from LMU Munich wanting to contribute to the OSC's activities. For instance, you will be recognized with the status of OSC Fellow if you (co-)lead a grassroot initiatives, (co-)organize an event, and/or (co-)deliver a workshop, on your own or with OSC staff or members. The OSC strives to provide [OSC Fellows](/people/fellows.qmd) with further leadership and training opportunities.

<a href="mailto:malika.ihle@lmu.de?subject=OSC%20Fellowship" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
  Become an OSC Fellow <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i>
</a>

:::
::::


### Institutional Members

:::: {.card .members-category .rounded-3 .shadow-sm .border-top .border-3 .border-start-0 .border-end-0 .border-bottom-0}
::: {.card-body .p-4}
Departments, faculties, units, or central institutions of the LMU that provide infrastructure or other services that facilitate the goals of the OSC can become [institutional members](/partners/institutional-members.html). Learn more about the benefits of becoming a funding institutional member below and schedule a call with us!

<a href="/partners/becoming-institutional-members.html" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">Learn more <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>

:::
